What does he want with a pew?”", "sha256": "3820f90a867d9a1138f575bae98be1af024ef62ebdef97a6f5f0673c7b391b3a", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[42]", "source_html": "“His’n? What does he want with a pew?”"}, {"id": "043-029-0043", "tag": "p", "text": "“Wants it to set in. What did you reckon he wanted with it?”", "sha256": "77c425ff80305b64c867f60c64582b54ddd1f4cf0056785914964a795cc61374", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[43]", "source_html": "“Wants it to set in. What did you reckon he wanted with it?”"}, {"id": "043-029-0044", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why, I thought he’d be in the pulpit.”", "sha256": "189152e4d6d018e8084c893e290c7594c9c33cc20f4fa85913b69ed1a09a1844", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[44]", "source_html": "“Why, I thought he’d be in the pulpit.”"}, {"id": "043-029-0045", "tag": "p", "text": "Rot him, I forgot he was a preacher. I see I was up a stump again, so I played another chicken bone and got another think. Then I says:", "sha256": "d488ed8e4c55dc6c5a25d4cdb1c379ae05697c3f435fabc50450ecc8f105f6f3", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[45]", "source_html": "Rot him, I forgot he was a preacher. I see I was up a stump again, so I played another chicken bone and got another think. Then I says:"}, {"id": "043-029-0046", "tag": "p", "text": "“Blame it, do you suppose there ain’t but one preacher to a church?”", "sha256": "04d850d62a711837c0874112d72feec4d2b5756b850c12ddb27dccc629dcbb2e", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[46]", "source_html": "“Blame it, do you suppose there ain’t but one preacher to a church?”"}, {"id": "043-029-0047", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why, what do they want with more?”", "sha256": "c0cf7fd525deb57ada980f0dd14bf96e7b68d1648d5c3be2037490ad720806f8", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[47]", "source_html": "“Why, what do they want with more?”"}, {"id": "043-029-0048", "tag": "p", "text": "“What!—to preach before a king? I never did see such a girl as you. They don’t have no less than seventeen.”", "sha256": "0e4615695205d379a1bbe9e30fd82db1f6f26a199dd61b73b86c3ccbc0673839", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[48]", "source_html": "“What!—to preach before a king? I never did see such a girl as you. They don’t have no less than seventeen.”"}, {"id": "043-029-0049", "tag": "p", "text": "“Seventeen! My land! Why, I wouldn’t set out such a string as that, not if I never got to glory. It must take ’em a week.”", "sha256": "4dcf0b009866d8b64d8da81cf37d7b14dc838b791aab3ab027fab93eae0a16c0", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[49]", "source_html": "“Seventeen! My land! Why, I wouldn’t set out such a string as that, not if I never got to glory. It must take ’em a week.”"}, {"id": "043-029-0050", "tag": "p", "text": "“Shucks, they don’t all of ’em preach the same day—only one of ’em.”", "sha256": "b5211349cc6743ca43b313dc7f2b5726f4ff8c44f606118af90976cb74fba5f0", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[50]", "source_html": "“Shucks, they don’t all of ’em preach the same day—only one of ’em.”"}, {"id": "043-029-0051", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, then, what does the rest of ’em do?”", "sha256": "7a55673212bc9fb923bafe87652ab079356e9a9b1fd47760964c4a8d124c0f87", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[51]", "source_html": "“Well, then, what does the rest of ’em do?”"}, {"id": "043-029-0052", "tag": "p", "text": "“Oh, nothing much. Loll around, pass the plate—and one thing or another. But mainly they don’t do nothing.”", "sha256": "b5339b745e8ad2736dce6781104368aeb899e76902e13b51001452b89ae31083", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[52]", "source_html": "“Oh, nothing much. Loll around, pass the plate—and one thing or another. But mainly they don’t do nothing.”"}, {"id": "043-029-0053", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, then, what are they for?”", "sha256": "aa7e2464799edea9be42c916304addbbeca60eeae08cfe076fe41f8b8dcbea52", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[53]", "source_html": "“Well, then, what are they for?”"}, {"id": "043-029-0054", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why, they’re for style. Don’t you know nothing?”", "sha256": "fa009a6a57a41655ed2aec647ce8c6d8ad0e7d4e3881890bd9df59a3c1768bce", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[54]", "source_html": "“Why, they’re for style. Don’t you know nothing?”"}, {"id": "043-029-0055", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, I don’t want to know no such foolishness as that. How is servants treated in England? Do they treat ’em better ’n we treat our niggers?”", "sha256": "2b5b8b700da11f9a0a82b07d23e2dcb46c748b27e45a87fdd3ede599d3bd26e4", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[55]", "source_html": "“Well, I don’t want to know no such foolishness as that. How is servants treated in England? Do they treat ’em better ’n we treat our niggers?”"}, {"id": "043-029-0056", "tag": "p", "text": "“No! A servant ain’t nobody there. They treat them worse than dogs.”", "sha256": "c06e12aa78ae04d1b57f7c79376719e4f43858aa6f3584dad108e574e53be0b8", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[56]", "source_html": "“No! A servant ain’t nobody there. They treat them worse than dogs.”"}, {"id": "043-029-0057", "tag": "p", "text": "“Don’t they give ’em holidays, the way we do, Christmas and New Year’s week, and Fourth of July?”", "sha256": "b088c0abc51534d777ecac35003ff5961a6675412b299a34ad0106b5ea118b7e", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[57]", "source_html": "“Don’t they give ’em holidays, the way we do, Christmas and New Year’s week, and Fourth of July?”"}, {"id": "043-029-0058", "tag": "p", "text": "“Oh, just listen! A body could tell you hain’t ever been to England by that. Why, Hare-l—why, Joanna, they never see a holiday from year’s end to year’s end; never go to the circus, nor theater, nor nigger shows, nor nowheres.”", "sha256": "c2cc370c1898d4b4c03261fd7c7a4f6d2abf5f8773caeebece3208cffc0f60b6", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[58]", "source_html": "“Oh, just listen! A body could tell you hain’t ever been to England by that. Why, Hare-l—why, Joanna, they never see a holiday from year’s end to year’s end; never go to the circus, nor theater, nor nigger shows, nor nowheres.”"}, {"id": "043-029-0059", "tag": "p", "text": "“Nor church?”", "sha256": "a4c0475ead58cf8d0b2ac54a062841bf42fcf77d3b91323382448255d047c818", "source_location": "div.chapter[31]/*[59]", "source_html": "“Nor church?”"}], "draft_rows": [{"source_id": "043-029-0040", "target": "«Чья скамья?»", "source_sha256": "d21cf5210ec40a62fcf2577934656dba2e726159909bf64133953145527d1dff", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0040", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "bcc26dd09d2cf6ae2a27e773523103f09af666b4ddf4b669a0a0ccdf390186a9"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0041", "target": "«Ну, на нашей… у твоего дяди Харви».", "source_sha256": "bb0490133a286d5e584705fc8ef737b888f74495cd26b2b23d65233c845e53f4", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0041", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "625389ba89a991ec701baec43536c1d419048221c8d23c5ad43d6d654f715eaf"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0042", "target": "«Его? Зачем ему скамья?»", "source_sha256": "3820f90a867d9a1138f575bae98be1af024ef62ebdef97a6f5f0673c7b391b3a", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0042", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "7d2c02f7e4eaef9097e7b912ed0315e6fe8803afeb79906995d5ac72ec472b74"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0043", "target": "«Хочет, чтобы это вошло в привычку. Как ты думаешь, зачем ему это понадобилось?»", "source_sha256": "77c425ff80305b64c867f60c64582b54ddd1f4cf0056785914964a795cc61374", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0043", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "7db6b68d44b4934923d2d346d8119ba3fd41665eb6be0bb4b1c49226bfa7951a"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0044", "target": "«Да я-то думал, что он будет на амвоне».", "source_sha256": "189152e4d6d018e8084c893e290c7594c9c33cc20f4fa85913b69ed1a09a1844", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0044", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "59bc775903ef66c5cecb24e1fdf17f5b3ed8fef069a614b355ca221f8ee94098"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0045", "target": "Чёрт возьми, я забыл, что он священник. Я понял, что опять зашел в тупик, поэтому снова сыграл картой с куриной косточкой и придумал новую отмазку. Тогда я говорю:", "source_sha256": "d488ed8e4c55dc6c5a25d4cdb1c379ae05697c3f435fabc50450ecc8f105f6f3", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0045", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "3156172a9b9b513095d95d1a033b8ad1231e886de50df6daa3eff90e44da449f"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0046", "target": "«Черт возьми, ты что, думаешь, в церкви только один священник?»", "source_sha256": "04d850d62a711837c0874112d72feec4d2b5756b850c12ddb27dccc629dcbb2e", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0046", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "78649ce3dbd4f12e515c39993fc4607992e22c30cb6b7d4a7ff68577c24e409e"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0047", "target": "«Ну, а зачем им ещё?»", "source_sha256": "c0cf7fd525deb57ada980f0dd14bf96e7b68d1648d5c3be2037490ad720806f8", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0047", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "dbcf10b7676c7f807f6df66a698e1f5c9756953179c6fa06d5099a3c683f1585"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0048", "target": "«Что?! — Проповедовать перед королём? Я ещё никогда не видел такой девушки, как ты. Их там не меньше семнадцати».", "source_sha256": "0e4615695205d379a1bbe9e30fd82db1f6f26a199dd61b73b86c3ccbc0673839", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0048", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "33a9e72743fb340a2377086a469c499afda83902840f70369cb46e103a36f19e"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0049", "target": "«Семнадцать! Боже мой! Да я бы и за всю жизнь не смог составить такую череду, даже если бы это принесло мне славу. Наверное, у них на это уходит целая неделя».", "source_sha256": "4dcf0b009866d8b64d8da81cf37d7b14dc838b791aab3ab027fab93eae0a16c0", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0049", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "764b90d72866d716ba63cb667e4de421bd89ab9815315412216a63d327f537c3"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0050", "target": "«Чёрт возьми, они же не все проповедуют в один и тот же день — только один из них».", "source_sha256": "b5211349cc6743ca43b313dc7f2b5726f4ff8c44f606118af90976cb74fba5f0", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0050", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "3f7142f61cd14775b12378e5454dfc4aab833a64ad024dfa8baeaf77735907d7"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0051", "target": "«Ну, а что же делают остальные?»", "source_sha256": "7a55673212bc9fb923bafe87652ab079356e9a9b1fd47760964c4a8d124c0f87", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0051", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "d02597d99550faab4f7c112d845a4da2d7912f11e76562662f6c1d51ce03a5b6"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0052", "target": "«О, ничего особенного. Поваляются, передают тарелку — и то одно, то другое. Но в основном они ничего не делают».", "source_sha256": "b5339b745e8ad2736dce6781104368aeb899e76902e13b51001452b89ae31083", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0052", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "a157219af87d1020b27afe158b5ec0d192de65325ace80ae435e0ba828ce7cb8"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0053", "target": "«Ну, тогда зачем они нужны?»", "source_sha256": "aa7e2464799edea9be42c916304addbbeca60eeae08cfe076fe41f8b8dcbea52", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0053", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "1b7f0a8f07eaef541ca8f4c5e310f8f8cd33abf9292ce728a7da91381fe80e3e"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0054", "target": "«Да ну, это же ради стиля. Ты что, ничего не знаешь?»", "source_sha256": "fa009a6a57a41655ed2aec647ce8c6d8ad0e7d4e3881890bd9df59a3c1768bce", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0054", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "30e75e82d16fdeb0497379e85277847eeb65088a31aae9ba846019a30bd7869d"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0055", "target": "«Ну, мне не интересно слушать такие глупости. А как в Англии обращаются с прислугой? Лучше ли они с ними обращаются, чем мы с нашими неграми?»", "source_sha256": "2b5b8b700da11f9a0a82b07d23e2dcb46c748b27e45a87fdd3ede599d3bd26e4", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0055", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "2d372a70b9e65525540ac0c0599d19920e430d91770f535b8822e8fa420d1997"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0056", "target": "«Нет! Слуга там ничтожество. С ними обращаются хуже, чем с собаками».", "source_sha256": "c06e12aa78ae04d1b57f7c79376719e4f43858aa6f3584dad108e574e53be0b8", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0056", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "8c6d4976286da42a24b1e1bd0b8a2993c6f9d8df5b0f9d143f629df3fd9904ad"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0057", "target": "«А им разве не дают каникул, как у нас, на Рождество, на Новый год и на Четвёртое июля?»", "source_sha256": "b088c0abc51534d777ecac35003ff5961a6675412b299a34ad0106b5ea118b7e", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0057", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "04070634a9d39116c5205785987ec6adc908baaf59a3a0ad734ec0911f781ed7"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0058", "target": "«О, только послушай! По этому можно сказать, что ты никогда не был в Англии. Да, Хэр-л… да, Джоанна, у них нет ни одного выходного с конца года до конца года; они никогда не ходят ни в цирк, ни в театр, ни на представления негров, никуда».", "source_sha256": "c2cc370c1898d4b4c03261fd7c7a4f6d2abf5f8773caeebece3208cffc0f60b6", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0058", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "1aad735fd3e57cdd49b3ac2a252e56ebcdd52c40204671171cc9b27b9c965d0d"}, {"source_id": "043-029-0059", "target": "«А в церковь?»", "source_sha256": "a4c0475ead58cf8d0b2ac54a062841bf42fcf77d3b91323382448255d047c818", "target_id": "ru-043-029-0059", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "f9626e87e7b370d7d1379ad862ce814a8fc0d757ba8e1ac75b0bf83b321d9ce0"}]}
